scripts.test:hosting: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,database --project demo-dabubble-auth "playwright test --config playwright.hosting.config.ts"
scripts.test:firebase: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,database --project demo-dabubble-auth "npm run test:firebase:run"
scripts.test:firebase:run: node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/deletion/*.test.mjs tests/security/*.test.mjs && playwright test --config playwright.firebase.config.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run check:files && npm run build && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:presence: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,database --project demo-dabubble-auth "node --test tests/security/presence.rules.test.mjs && playwright test --config playwright.firebase.config.ts tests/firebase/presence.spec.ts"
